title: Learning, Development and Training Delivery Specialists
shortDescription: Expression of Interest. 12-month engagement supporting ADELE, the Defence training content delivery platform, designing and delivering Signals and Radio Frequency training. Canberra or remote. Mid to Senior level, multiple roles.
opportunity: We're building a small bench of training specialists for ADELE, the Defence training content delivery platform, and we want to hear from people who know what good Signals and Radio Frequency training actually looks like. This is a 12-month engagement with the option to extend. The work is anchored in Canberra, but we're open to remote delivery for the right people. You'll join a multidisciplinary team designing, redesigning, and delivering training products that take learners through the foundations of military communications, including waveforms, information formatting, channel coding, and multiplexing, so they come out the other side with real, applied understanding. If you've built training that holds up under scrutiny, instructed in classrooms or in the field, or rebuilt a course because the old one wasn't landing the learning outcomes it needed to, we'd like to hear from you.
whatYoullBeDoing: Working across ADELE's training portfolio, you'll take Signals and RF content from concept through to delivery. In any given week that could look like: Designing new courses from learning outcomes up, or redesigning courses that aren't getting the results they should Mapping and rationalising existing training products so the right content reaches the right audience without duplication or gaps Prototyping course structures, learning sequences, and assessment approaches before they hit the platform Translating dense technical content (waveforms, channel coding, multiplexing, information formatting) into accessible, instructionally sound learning material Delivering training directly, whether in person, through ADELE, or in blended formats Working alongside subject matter experts, instructional designers, and platform engineers to keep content current, accurate, and tied to capability needs Capturing learner feedback and iterating on materials so courses keep improving You won't be siloed. You'll own your courses, communicate clearly about progress and blockers, and ask good questions when you need to.
whatWereLookingFor: You'll bring experience across some of the following, and a willingness to grow in the areas you haven't touched yet:
Military Signals or Radio Frequency background, with hands-on exposure to tactical communications, waveforms, or radio systems
Training delivery experience, ideally in a Defence or structured instructional setting
Course design or redesign, including writing learning outcomes, building assessments, and structuring lesson plans
ADF instructor qualifications or equivalent adult learning credentials (Cert IV TAE, Workplace Trainer and Assessor, or similar)
Comfort with the technical subject matter including communications fundamentals, information theory basics, channel coding, and multiplexing
Experience working with digital training platforms or learning management systems
You won't need to tick every box. We care more about how you think about training and what you've actually built or delivered than the length of your certification list.
What Matters More Than Your CV
Instructional honesty. You design for learning outcomes, not for filling time slots. If a module isn't working, you change it.
Subject matter respect. You take the time to get the Signals content right. You won't ship a slide you don't understand yourself.
A practitioner's mindset. You've delivered training, not just designed it. You know what fails in the room.
Clear communication. You can explain a complex waveform concept to a brand-new learner without dumbing it down.
Pragmatism over polish. You'd rather ship a course that works and iterate than chase a perfect storyboard for six months.
Good training isn't about what you put in front of learners. It's about what they walk out knowing how to do.
securityClearance: Given the nature of our work in defence and government, candidates must be eligible to apply for an Australian Defence Security Clearance. Australian citizenship is required to meet this eligibility.

title: Software Engineer
shortDescription: We're on the lookout for a Software Engineer with 3–5 years of experience who brings solid fundamentals and a genuine enthusiasm for learning.
opportunity: We're on the lookout for a Software Engineer with 3–5 years of experience who brings solid fundamentals and, most importantly, a genuine enthusiasm for learning. You won't need to tick every box — we care far more about how you think, how you approach problems, and how you work with others than whether you've used every tool in our stack. This is a hybrid role based in Melbourne, with flexibility to work from home alongside time spent collaborating with the team in-office.
whatYoullBeDoing: Working closely with our technical leads and delivery team, you'll contribute to the design, development, and delivery of software solutions across a range of client engagements. Day to day, you might be building out API integrations, writing clean backend logic, collaborating on database design, or refining a frontend component — often all in the same week.
whatWereLookingFor: Server-side development using Microsoft .NET and C#
Database development skills including both SQL DDL and DML
ORM and data access frameworks such as Entity Framework Core, SQLite PCL
API development and integration — RESTful or otherwise
Architecture and design patterns such as dependency injection, CQRS and the Mediator pattern (e.g. MediatR)
Frontend development with one or more modern frameworks (Vue.js, Angular, React, Blazor or similar) and component libraries like Telerik or PrimeVue
Automated testing using frameworks such as xUnit and Playwright, including unit testing and mocking
CI/CD pipelines — experience here is a bonus, but familiarity is valued
bonusPoints: Working with Large Language Models (LLMs) — whether cloud-based or locally hosted
Exposure to AI tooling or building AI-integrated features
